channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Duncan Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Duncan Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
“I think everything's been said. It was an unfortunate play. If opponents are thinking that Duncan is the enforcer and the overly physical defender, then that means we're doing some good things.”

Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson, Feb 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Duncan Robinson, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Bam Adebayo on the Duncan-Jaylen situation:

“I agree with Duncan. He felt like it was a dirty play. I’m not going against my teammate. I stand behind my teammates 100%.”

Bam Adebayo on Duncan Robinson, Jaylen Brown, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Nikola Jovic:

“For sure, for sure. I’m sure I’m more ready. More ready mentally and physically. The shot also is going to help me a lot. We have some great players that dominate the paint like Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo. If you get a wide open three, they want you to make it. That’s why you have guys like Max Strus and Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, K-Love (Kevin Love) who always are going to make shots and they needed to be great to be where we were last year. It’s something we need and it’s something I’m trying to just think about all the time and be ready and confident. Because when I get it, I know they want me to make it.”

Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, Sep 25, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Orlando Robinson on Pat Riley, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Orlando Robinson said last week.

“So I’m just going to take this opportunity to the fullest and I’m actually glad to be here. I’ve heard a lot about how Pat Riley and the Miami Heat develop players like Duncan Robinson and a couple other guys. Just seeing that and just knowing my own nature that I feel like Miami is a really good fit for me.”

Orlando Robinson on Pat Riley, Duncan Robinson, Jul 7, 2022. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Spoelstra on not playing Duncan Robinson in Game 4:

“I was probably like everybody else. Right after the game and I'm looking at the three-point percentages. I'm like, 'Wow, we could have really used him.'This is how fast a series can move and can change.”

Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson, May 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Spo on Duncan Robinson perhaps playing tonight:

“I’m not Nostradamus … and it’s all hands on deck. Duncan has kept himself ready. He’s right there. So we’ll see what happens tonight.”

Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson, May 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on Duncan Robinson:

“We all know Duncan can get hot like that. We need Duncan to play like that.”

Jimmy Butler on Duncan Robinson, Apr 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: PJ Tucker on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Tucker on Robinson:

“He's one of the best shooters I've ever seen in my life.”

PJ Tucker on Duncan Robinson, Apr 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Pat Riley on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Pat Riley on the decision to re-sign Duncan Robinson:

“Right now the 3-point shot has to be really dealt with on both ends of the court: How are you going to defend it, and then you better have three or four guys who can make them when it counts.”

Pat Riley on Duncan Robinson, Oct 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Pat Riley on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
“Duncan is the epitome of everybody who’s ever had a dream about being a great NBA player,”

Pat Riley on Duncan Robinson, Aug 6, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ben Simmons, Duncan Robinson, Kendrick Nunn, Tyler Herro
item.description:
one Western Conference coach told HoopsHype.

“I think Simmons is more versatile. I’d just surround him with shooters and open the floor up like Milwaukee for Giannis. There can be more creativity with Simmons on the offensive end. I would try to trade Embiid to Miami and get some of their young, hungry shooters and guards like Tyler Herro, Kendrick Nunn, Duncan Robinson, etc. Ideally, I’d get Bam, but I doubt Miami would trade him.”

Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ben Simmons, Duncan Robinson, Kendrick Nunn, Tyler Herro, Aug 24, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Tyler Herro, on the Pacers' isolation attack plans,

“It's no secret who they're going at, they're going at me and Duncan.”

Tyler Herro on Duncan Robinson, Aug 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra:

“Our guys understand how important Duncan is to our overall productivity. Bam and Jimmy get that.”

Erik Spoelstra on Duncan Robinson, Aug 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Jae Crowder on Kyle Korver, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
“I’ve played with a few. Probably top two. I think about Kyle Korver and I think about Duncan.“To be honest with you, Kyle Korver comes off one way, though. Duncan is coming off both sides, so he’s a little more dynamic in that sense. I don’t want to say he’s a better shooter, but he’s more dynamic because really Kyle Korver wants to come off the left side of the floor. If you notice, he wants to come off that left side corner. So, Duncan can come out and play both sides. He’s a little more dynamic.”

Jae Crowder on Kyle Korver, Duncan Robinson, Apr 16, 2020. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Now it appears all might be not be as it appears with Robinson's immediate future, with Heat President Pat Riley providing insight on the 3-point specialist's plans in advance of training camp.

“I'm really proud in the fact that Duncan Robinson has been invited to play in the international series,”

Pat Riley on Duncan Robinson, Aug 25, 2018. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.
